admin.uploads.help_body:
Upload limits

Upload tiering
New uploads land in a fast internal pool first and later migrate to capacity storage.

USB / removable pools are automatically blocked for safety.

Worker interval
How often the migration worker wakes up and scans landing storage.

Minimum landing age
A file must remain in landing at least this long before migration is allowed.

Max files per pass
Maximum number of eligible files migrated during one worker scan.

Example:
interval = 60
min age = 60
max/pass = 8

Worker wakes every 60 seconds, migrates files older than 60 seconds, and processes up to 8 files each cycle.
admin.uploads.help_intro: Upload tiering lets new uploads land in a fast internal pool first and later migrate to capacity storage.
admin.uploads.help_landing_body: Select an internal pool for landing. USB and removable pools are automatically blocked for safety.
admin.uploads.help_safety: Upload tiering is not a backup feature. It only controls where new uploads land first and how they are later moved.
admin.uploads.help_worker_body: Worker interval controls how often the worker wakes up. Minimum landing age controls how old a file must be before it can be moved. Max files per pass controls how many eligible files are moved during one worker pass.
admin.uploads.note1: These values control how often the migration worker runs and how aggressively it drains landing storage.
admin.uploads.note2: lets new uploads land in a fast pool first, then migrate to capacity storage.
admin.uploads.note3: Select an internal pool for landing. USB and removable pools are automatically blocked for safety.
admin.uploads.note4: The migration worker later moves files to capacity pools according to the tiering policy.
